title: Interval Observer Design Using Observability Decomposition for Detectable Linear Systems
summary: We provide a systematic interval observer design method for detectable linear time-invariant (LTI) systems, where a part of the state is observable from the measured output. An observability-based invertible LTI transformation decomposes the state into two parts. The first part is decoupled from the other and observable from the output, while the second is affected by the first, does not appear in the output, but is detectable.
